_comment: Mutation scope for research/run_mutation_tests.py. Maps each compiler module to the test subset that must detect wrong behaviour in it. 'seed' fixes mutant selection; per-module 'max_mutants' overrides the driver default. quantization.py is probed against both its dedicated edge-case suite and the native clip/emit semantics suites, because native.py consumes its multiplier/shift/rounding arithmetic.
